## SEO Agent — Schedule Catch-up (R94, 2026-10-16)
A cron fire lives only in n8n's memory: a **restart, a deploy or a re-publish re-arms every schedule for its NEXT time**, so a fire that was due and not yet delivered is lost (the 2026-10-12 16:38 deploy restart dropped five Monday runs), and while the Mac sleeps the timers stop, so fires arrive late.
**Doors:** *Instance Started* (n8n's own `init` event; waits 45 s for the instance to settle) — every schedule has just been re-armed, so a past fire not yet run is certainly lost; *Sweep (every 15 min)* (`7,22,37,52 * * * *`) — a schedule re-published after its due time lost its fire too, and a fire left hanging by sleep is started once it is 30 min late (its delayed timer is then refused by its own run guard); *Catch-up Run* — a test (`{ plan_only?, dry_run?, now? }`; `now` only with `plan_only`). No execution time-out (C-1: n8n counts it in wall-clock time, so a Mac asleep mid-node cancelled sweep 728); instead a plan older than 10 min is never acted on.
**Evidence:** n8n's public API (credential *n8n API (SEO Agent catch-up)* from `N8N_API_KEY`): the workflow (on? last published = schedule re-armed) and its executions — mode `trigger` is a fire; an on-demand run does **not** count as the week's scheduled run (owner decision, `count_on_demand`). The catch-up's own records in `seo_cache` (`catchup:<workflow>:<due ISO>`), the live reservations in `seo_run_ledger`.
**Start:** RECORD the key (with this execution's claim), read it back (*Confirm Claim*: two sweeps racing start a fire once), THEN start the workflow through its own manual entry with no site (`{ trigger: 'catchup', scheduled_for, why, late_min }` - its report says it ran late and why), so it runs every site exactly as its schedule does and passes its own ledger row and concurrency gate; at most 2 a sweep, 30 s apart, never more than the run guard has room for. A slot stays due for its whole period (a Monday run missed on Monday is the week's run until the next Monday, a monthly one all month) unless its next fire is close, never one due before the catch-up first ran. A start that failed, was refused, never appeared (the sweep stopped after recording it) or was cancelled before it finished is tried again, 3 attempts in all. A dry run (`catchup_dry:` keys) starts only AI Growth (no Bing / IndexNow submission) and the Content Cadence (plans only).
**Record:** `seo_cache` `catchup:last` (tests: `catchup:last_test`) — one line per schedule with its due time and verdict. Successful executions are not kept (every 15 minutes).
Time zone **America/New_York** (GENERIC_TIMEZONE, set in n8n/compose.yml).

| Workflow | cron | kind | manual entry |
|---|---|---|---|
| AI Pulse | `30 6 * * *` | daily | Manual Run |
| Page Watch | `45 5 * * *` | daily | Watch Run |
